              "rendered" : {
                "uuid-1" : "\n    <div\n    >\n    <h2>Custom Packages</h2>\n<p>Are you looking for the ultimate in Costa Rica vacations? Our team oat TravelLux will design your custom vacation package. We do not sell cookie-cutter trips. Instead, we take the time to get to know your unique &ldquo;travel personality&rdquo;. Then we match you with a hand-picked selection of housing, tours &amp; transportation options. The result is a tailor-made Costa Rica journey that will fit you like a glove.</p>\n<p>We email you a detailed travel itinerary filled with info, pictures and videos. Your TravelLux agent will work with you to adjust your vacation package until you are 100% satisfied. This makes for a seamless, worry-free experience that allows you to relax &amp; enjoy the voyage.</p>\n<p><a href=\"/contact-us/\" class=\"btn btn-primary\">Book Now</a></p>\n</div><div></div>",
                "uuid-2" : "\n    <div></div>",
                "uuid-3" : "\n    <div\n    >\n    <h2>Costa Rica Family Adventure</h2>\n<p>Tropical rainforests, zip lines, monkey sightings and waterfall swims make for the most unforgettable vacation&mdash;and photos.</p>\n<p>Abundance abounds in Costa Rica: beautiful beaches, friendly people and endless adventures to embark upon. We dabble in it all with a family-friendly itinerary that will get everyone&rsquo;s heart pumping. Jump right in to adventure life in Costa Rica at Arenal Volcano where we zip along the treetops, get a glimpse of rural Tico life on a local farm, rappel down a canyon waterfall that lies deep in the tropical rainforest, and soak in thermal hot springs.</p>\n<p>Journey south, crossing Lake Arenal by boat, and dive deep into the Monteverde cloud forest. Your hotel is located in the reserve, home to eight different biological zones and thousands of plants and animals. Keep your eyes peeled for monkeys and quetzals during the day and embark on night walks with your guide to experience a whole different world after dark. Spend a unique day exploring the forest giants from the ground up&mdash;climbing up specially outfitted trees and then exploring the forest on foot with your naturalist guide.</p>\n</div><div></div>",
                "uuid-4" : "\n    <div\n    >\n    <h3>Adventure travel done right</h3>\n<p>Wherever you want to go, whatever you want to get into, we&rsquo;ve got a trip that&rsquo;ll make your dream vacation come true. Visit like a local, explore at your own pace, and eat like a king (or a vegan king, if that&rsquo;s more your thing).<strong><br /></strong></p>\n</div><div></div>",
                "uuid-5" : "\n    <div\n    >\n    <h3>Experience the world with us</h3>\n<p>We practice Leave No Trace principles on all our trips and work with local people and businesses as often as possible.Our expert guides don&rsquo;t just know these places&mdash;they call them home. Their local knowledge unveils worlds few get to see. Hike, bike, swim and paddle with like-minded travelers who share your passion for adventure and the outdoors.</p>\n</div><div></div>",
                "uuid-6" : "\n    <h2>Costa Rica FAQ</h2>\n\n<div class=\"card-group-custom card-group-corporate\" id=\"accordion1\" role=\"tablist\" aria-multiselectable=\"false\">\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordion566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\" aria-controls=\"accordion566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        What is the cheapest month to fly to Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\">High season is considered to be June, July and August. The cheapest month to fly to Costa Rica is September.</div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-headingec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordionec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" aria-controls=\"accordionec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        How far in advance do I need to book a travel package?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordionec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-headingec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p>You can start peeking at <b>flights</b> at this time. According to our experience, the best time to <b>book</b> internationa <b>flights</b> from the US is 5-6 months out. The best time to purchase <b>tickets</b> to Costa Rica is approximately 70 days out and the prime <b>booking</b> window is 2 weeks to 6 months out. The earlier you choose your package the better so that we can find you the best accomodations and event reservations at the best price.</p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" aria-controls=\"accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        Is it cheap to vacation in Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p><b>Costa Rica</b><span>&nbsp;may be more expensive than some other Central American countries, but you can certainly experience the country on a backpacker's budget if you take the time to investigate low-cost sleeping options like camping, hostels and small eco guest houses. Budget travelers can survive on around $30 &ndash; $50 USD per day.</span></p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" aria-controls=\"accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        Do you need a visa for Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p><span>To enter&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>, your passport must be valid for at least three months after arrival.&nbsp;</span><b>You</b><span>&nbsp;also must have a return or onward ticket. Citizens of the United States, Canada and most European nations&nbsp;</span><b>do</b><span>&nbsp;not&nbsp;</span><b>need a visa</b><span>. Tourists are generally permitted to stay in&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>&nbsp;for up to 90 days.</span></p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordion6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" aria-controls=\"accordion6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        What shots do I need for Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p><span>The CDC and WHO recommend the following vaccinations for&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>: hepatitis A, hepatitis B, typhoid, yellow fever, rabies, meningitis, polio, measles, mumps and rubella (MMR), Tdap (tetanus, diphtheria and pertussis), chickenpox, shingles, pneumonia and influenza.</span></p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n    </div><div></div>"
              },

                  "title" : "Experience the world with us",
                  "body" : "<h3>Experience the world with us</h3>\n<p>We practice Leave No Trace principles on all our trips and work with local people and businesses as often as possible.Our expert guides don&rsquo;t just know these places&mdash;they call them home. <div class=\" col-lg-6  \"><!-- Column -->\n                                                                                \n<div\n    >\n    <h2>Custom Packages</h2>\n<p>Are you looking for the ultimate in Costa Rica vacations? Our team oat TravelLux will design your custom vacation package. We do not sell cookie-cutter trips. Instead, we take the time to get to know your unique &ldquo;travel personality&rdquo;. Then we match you with a hand-picked selection of housing, tours &amp; transportation options. The result is a tailor-made Costa Rica journey that will fit you like a glove.</p>\n<p>We email you a detailed travel itinerary filled with info, pictures and videos. Your TravelLux agent will work with you to adjust your vacation package until you are 100% satisfied. This makes for a seamless, worry-free experience that allows you to relax &amp; enjoy the voyage.</p>\n<p><a href=\"/contact-us/\" class=\"btn btn-primary\">Book Now</a></p>\n</div><div></div>\n                                    </div><!-- Column -->\n\n                                                                    \n                                                \n                                                                                                \n                                    <div class=\" col-lg-6  \"><!-- Column -->\n                                                                                \n<div></div>\n                                    </div><!-- Column -->\n\n                                                        </div><!-- /row -->\n                            </div><!-- /container -->\n                        </section><!-- /section -->\n                                                                                                                                                    \n                        <section id=\"section-3\" class=\"section \"><!-- section -->\n                            <div class=\"container\"><!-- container -->\n                                <div class=\"row\"><!-- row -->\n                        \n                                                \n                                                                                                \n                                    <div class=\" col-lg-12  \"><!-- Column -->\n                                                                                \n<div\n    >\n    <h2>Costa Rica Family Adventure</h2>\n<p>Tropical rainforests, zip lines, monkey sightings and waterfall swims make for the most unforgettable vacation&mdash;and photos.</p>\n<p>Abundance abounds in Costa Rica: beautiful beaches, friendly people and endless adventures to embark upon. We dabble in it all with a family-friendly itinerary that will get everyone&rsquo;s heart pumping. Jump right in to adventure life in Costa Rica at Arenal Volcano where we zip along the treetops, get a glimpse of rural Tico life on a local farm, rappel down a canyon waterfall that lies deep in the tropical rainforest, and soak in thermal hot springs.</p>\n<p>Journey south, crossing Lake Arenal by boat, and dive deep into the Monteverde cloud forest. Your hotel is located in the reserve, home to eight different biological zones and thousands of plants and animals. Keep your eyes peeled for monkeys and quetzals during the day and embark on night walks with your guide to experience a whole different world after dark. Spend a unique day exploring the forest giants from the ground up&mdash;climbing up specially outfitted trees and then exploring the forest on foot with your naturalist guide.</p>\n</div><div></div>\n                                    </div><!-- Column -->\n\n                                                        </div><!-- /row -->\n                            </div><!-- /container -->\n                        </section><!-- /section -->\n                                                                                                                                                    \n                        <section id=\"section-4\" class=\"section justify-content-around\"><!-- section -->\n                            <div class=\"container\"><!-- container -->\n                                <div class=\"row\"><!-- row -->\n                        \n                                                \n                                                                                                \n                                    <div class=\" col-lg-5  \"><!-- Column -->\n                                                                                \n<div\n    >\n    <h3>Adventure travel done right</h3>\n<p>Wherever you want to go, whatever you want to get into, we&rsquo;ve got a trip that&rsquo;ll make your dream vacation come true. Visit like a local, explore at your own pace, and eat like a king (or a vegan king, if that&rsquo;s more your thing).<strong><br /></strong></p>\n</div><div></div>\n                                    </div><!-- Column -->\n\n                                                                    \n                                                \n                                                                                                \n                                    <div class=\" col-lg-5 offset-lg-1 \"><!-- Column -->\n                                                                                \n<div\n    >\n    <h3>Experience the world with us</h3>\n<p>We practice Leave No Trace principles on all our trips and work with local people and businesses as often as possible.Our expert guides don&rsquo;t just know these places&mdash;they call them home. Their local knowledge unveils worlds few get to see. Hike, bike, swim and paddle with like-minded travelers who share your passion for adventure and the outdoors.</p>\n</div><div></div>\n                                    </div><!-- Column -->\n\n                                                                                                                               \n                        <section id=\"section-5\" class=\"section \"><!-- section -->\n                            <div class=\"container\"><!-- container -->\n                                <div class=\"row\"><!-- row -->\n                        \n                                                \n                                                                                                \n                                    <div class=\" col-lg-10 offset-lg-1 \"><!-- Column -->\n                                                                                \n<h2>Costa Rica FAQ</h2>\n\n<div class=\"card-group-custom card-group-corporate\" id=\"accordion1\" role=\"tablist\" aria-multiselectable=\"false\">\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordion566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\" aria-controls=\"accordion566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        What is the cheapest month to fly to Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\">High season is considered to be June, July and August. The cheapest month to fly to Costa Rica is September.</div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-headingec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordionec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" aria-controls=\"accordionec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        How far in advance do I need to book a travel package?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordionec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-headingec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p>You can start peeking at <b>flights</b> at this time. According to our experience, the best time to <b>book</b> internationa <b>flights</b> from the US is 5-6 months out. The best time to purchase <b>tickets</b> to Costa Rica is approximately 70 days out and the prime <b>booking</b> window is 2 weeks to 6 months out. The earlier you choose your package the better so that we can find you the best accomodations and event reservations at the best price.</p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" aria-controls=\"accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        Is it cheap to vacation in Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p><b>Costa Rica</b><span>&nbsp;may be more expensive than some other Central American countries, but you can certainly experience the country on a backpacker's budget if you take the time to investigate low-cost sleeping options like camping, hostels and small eco guest houses. Budget travelers can survive on around $30 &ndash; $50 USD per day.</span></p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" aria-controls=\"accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        Do you need a visa for Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p><span>To enter&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>, your passport must be valid for at least three months after arrival.&nbsp;</span><b>You</b><span>&nbsp;also must have a return or onward ticket. Citizens of the United States, Canada and most European nations&nbsp;</span><b>do</b><span>&nbsp;not&nbsp;</span><b>need a visa</b><span>. Tourists are generally permitted to stay in&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>&nbsp;for up to 90 days.</span></p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordion6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" aria-controls=\"accordion6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        What shots do I need for Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p><span>The CDC and WHO recommend the following vaccinations for&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>: hepatitis A, hepatitis B, typhoid, yellow fever, rabies, meningitis, polio, measles, mumps and rubella (MMR), Tdap (tetanus, diphtheria and pertussis), chickenpox, shingles, pneumonia and influenza.</span></p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n    </div><div></div>\n                                    </div><!-- Column -->\n\n Our team oat TravelLux will design your custom vacation package. We do not sell cookie-cutter trips. Instead, we take the time to get to know your unique &ldquo;travel personality&rdquo;. Then we match you with a hand-picked selection of housing, tours &amp; transportation options. The result is a tailor-made Costa Rica journey that will fit you like a glove.</p>\n<p>We email you a detailed travel itinerary filled with info, pictures and videos. Your TravelLux agent will work with you to adjust your vacation package until you are 100% satisfied. This makes for a seamless, worry-free experience that allows you to relax &amp; enjoy the voyage.</p>\n<p><a href=\"/contact-us/\" class=\"btn btn-primary\">Book Now</a></p>\n<article    \r\n<h1 class=\"text-center\">Featured Activities</h1>\n<div class=\"row justify-content-center\">\n    </div>\n<div></div>"},{"uuid":"uuid-5","render":"\n    <h2>Costa Rica Family Adventure</h2>\n<p>Tropical rainforests, zip lines, monkey sightings and waterfall swims make for the most unforgettable vacation&mdash;and photos.</p>\n<p>Abundance abounds in Costa Rica: beautiful beaches, friendly people and endless adventures to embark upon. We dabble in it all with a family-friendly itinerary that will get everyone&rsquo;s heart pumping. Jump right in to adventure life in Costa Rica at Arenal Volcano where we zip along the treetops, get a glimpse of rural Tico life on a local farm, rappel down a canyon waterfall that lies deep in the tropical rainforest, and soak in thermal hot springs.</p>\n<p>Journey south, crossing Lake Arenal by boat, and dive deep into the Monteverde cloud forest. Your hotel is located in the reserve, home to eight different biological zones and thousands of plants and animals. Keep your eyes peeled for monkeys and quetzals during the day and embark on night walks with your guide to experience a whole different world after dark. Spend a unique day exploring the forest giants from the ground up&mdash;climbing up specially outfitted trees and then exploring the forest on foot with your naturalist guide.</p><div></div>"},{"uuid":"uuid-6","render":"\n    <h3>Adventure travel done right</h3>\n<p>Wherever you want to go, whatever you want to get into, we&rsquo;ve got a trip that&rsquo;ll make your dream vacation come true. Visit like a local, explore at your own pace, and eat like a king (or a vegan king, if that&rsquo;s more your thing).<strong><br /></strong></p><div></div>"},{"uuid":"uuid-7","render":"\n    <h3>Experience the world with us</h3>\n<p>We practice Leave No Trace principles on all our trips and work with local people and businesses as often as possible.Our expert guides don&rsquo;t just know these places&mdash;they call them home. Their local knowledge unveils worlds few get to see. Hike, bike, swim and paddle with like-minded travelers who share your passion for adventure and the outdoors.</p><div></div>"},{"uuid":"uuid-8","render":"\n    \n<article class=\"thumbnail-classic \n</article>\n<div></div>"},{"uuid":"uuid-9","render":"\n    <h2>Costa Rica FAQ</h2>\n\n<div class=\"card-group-custom card-group-corporate\" id=\"accordion1\" role=\"tablist\" aria-multiselectable=\"false\">\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\" href=\"#accordion566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\" aria-controls=\"accordion566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        What is the cheapest month to fly to Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\">High season is considered to be June, July and August. The cheapest month to fly to Costa Rica is September.</div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-headingec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordionec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" aria-controls=\"accordionec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        How far in advance do I need to book a travel package?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordionec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-headingec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p>You can start peeking at <b>flights</b> at this time. According to our experience, the best time to <b>book</b> internationa <b>flights</b> from the US is 5-6 months out. The best time to purchase <b>tickets</b> to Costa Rica is approximately 70 days out and the prime <b>booking</b> window is 2 weeks to 6 months out. The earlier you choose your package the better so that we can find you the best accomodations and event reservations at the best price.</p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" aria-controls=\"accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        Is it cheap to vacation in Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p><b>Costa Rica</b><span>&nbsp;may be more expensive than some other Central American countries, but you can certainly experience the country on a backpacker's budget if you take the time to investigate low-cost sleeping options like camping, hostels and small eco guest houses. Budget travelers can survive on around $30 &ndash; $50 USD per day.</span></p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" aria-controls=\"accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        Do you need a visa for Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p><span>To enter&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>, your passport must be valid for at least three months after arrival.&nbsp;</span><b>You</b><span>&nbsp;also must have a return or onward ticket. Citizens of the United States, Canada and most European nations&nbsp;</span><b>do</b><span>&nbsp;not&nbsp;</span><b>need a visa</b><span>. Tourists are generally permitted to stay in&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>&nbsp;for up to 90 days.</span></p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordion6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" aria-controls=\"accordion6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        What shots do I need for Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p><span>The CDC and WHO recommend the following vaccinations for&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>: hepatitis A, hepatitis B, typhoid, yellow fever, rabies, meningitis, polio, measles, mumps and rubella (MMR), Tdap (tetanus, diphtheria and pertussis), chickenpox, shingles, pneumonia and influenza.</span></p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n Our team oat TravelLux will design your custom vacation package. We do not sell cookie-cutter trips. Instead, we take the time to get to know your unique &ldquo;travel personality&rdquo;. Then we match you with a hand-picked selection of housing, tours &amp; transportation options. The result is a tailor-made Costa Rica journey that will fit you like a glove.</p>\n<p>We email you a detailed travel itinerary filled with info, pictures and videos. Your TravelLux agent will work with you to adjust your vacation package until you are 100% satisfied. This makes for a seamless, worry-free experience that allows you to relax &amp; enjoy the voyage.</p>\n<p><a href=\"/contact-us/\" class=\"btn btn-primary\">Book Now</a></p>\n<article    \r\n<h1 class=\"text-center\">Featured Activities</h1>\n<div class=\"row justify-content-center\">\n    </div>\n<div></div>"},{"uuid":"uuid-5","render":"\n    <h2>Costa Rica Family Adventure</h2>\n<p>Tropical rainforests, zip lines, monkey sightings and waterfall swims make for the most unforgettable vacation&mdash;and photos.</p>\n<p>Abundance abounds in Costa Rica: beautiful beaches, friendly people and endless adventures to embark upon. We dabble in it all with a family-friendly itinerary that will get everyone&rsquo;s heart pumping. Jump right in to adventure life in Costa Rica at Arenal Volcano where we zip along the treetops, get a glimpse of rural Tico life on a local farm, rappel down a canyon waterfall that lies deep in the tropical rainforest, and soak in thermal hot springs.</p>\n<p>Journey south, crossing Lake Arenal by boat, and dive deep into the Monteverde cloud forest. Your hotel is located in the reserve, home to eight different biological zones and thousands of plants and animals. Keep your eyes peeled for monkeys and quetzals during the day and embark on night walks with your guide to experience a whole different world after dark. Spend a unique day exploring the forest giants from the ground up&mdash;climbing up specially outfitted trees and then exploring the forest on foot with your naturalist guide.</p><div></div>"},{"uuid":"uuid-6","render":"\n    <h3>Adventure travel done right</h3>\n<p>Wherever you want to go, whatever you want to get into, we&rsquo;ve got a trip that&rsquo;ll make your dream vacation come true. Visit like a local, explore at your own pace, and eat like a king (or a vegan king, if that&rsquo;s more your thing).<strong><br /></strong></p><div></div>"},{"uuid":"uuid-7","render":"\n    <h3>Experience the world with us</h3>\n<p>We practice Leave No Trace principles on all our trips and work with local people and businesses as often as possible.Our expert guides don&rsquo;t just know these places&mdash;they call them home. Their local knowledge unveils worlds few get to see. Hike, bike, swim and paddle with like-minded travelers who share your passion for adventure and the outdoors.</p><div></div>"},{"uuid":"uuid-8","render":"\n    \n<article class=\"thumbnail-classic class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading566d77ef-e52d-4404-802c-f1821c0b0a2d\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\">High season is considered to be June, July and August. The cheapest month to fly to Costa Rica is September.</div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-headingec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordionec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" aria-controls=\"accordionec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        How far in advance do I need to book a travel package?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordionec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-headingec596a66-a991-4f9e-93e5-0968f8aa7e26\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p>You can start peeking at <b>flights</b> at this time. According to our experience, the best time to <b>book</b> internationa <b>flights</b> from the US is 5-6 months out. The best time to purchase <b>tickets</b> to Costa Rica is approximately 70 days out and the prime <b>booking</b> window is 2 weeks to 6 months out. The earlier you choose your package the better so that we can find you the best accomodations and event reservations at the best price.</p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" aria-controls=\"accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        Is it cheap to vacation in Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p><b>Costa Rica</b><span>&nbsp;may be more expensive than some other Central American countries, but you can certainly experience the country on a backpacker's budget if you take the time to investigate low-cost sleeping options like camping, hostels and small eco guest houses. Budget travelers can survive on around $30 &ndash; $50 USD per day.</span></p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div class=\"card-title\">\n                    <a role=\"button\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#accordion1\" href=\"#accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" aria-controls=\"accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        Do you need a visa for Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby=\"accordion-heading015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7\">\n                <div class=\"card-body\"><p><span>To enter&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>, your passport must be valid for at least three months after arrival.&nbsp;</span><b>You</b><span>&nbsp;also must have a return or onward ticket. Citizens of the United States, Canada and most European nations&nbsp;</span><b>do</b><span>&nbsp;not&nbsp;</span><b>need a visa</b><span>. Tourists are generally permitted to stay in&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>&nbsp;for up to 90 days.</span></p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class=\"card card-custom card-corporate\">\n            <div class=\"card-header\" id=\"accordion-heading6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" role=\"tab\">\n                                    <div aria-controls=\"accordion6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" aria-expanded=\"false\" class=\"collapsed\">\n                        What shots do I need for Costa Rica?\n                        <div class=\"card-arrow\"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"collapse\" id=\"accordion6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4\" for&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>: hepatitis A, hepatitis B, typhoid, yellow fever, rabies, meningitis, polio, measles, mumps and rubella (MMR), Tdap (tetanus, diphtheria and pertussis), The earlier you choose your package the better so that we can find you the best accomodations and event reservations at the best price.</p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class="card card-custom card-corporate">\n            <div class="card-header" id="accordion-heading7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa" role="tab">\n                                    <div class="card-title">\n                    <a role="button" data-toggle="collapse" data-parent="#accordion1" href="#accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa" aria-controls="accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa" aria-expanded="false" class="collapsed">\n                        Is it cheap to vacation in Costa Rica?\n                        <div class="card-arrow"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class="collapse" id="accordion7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="accordion-heading7adf4569-74a5-4422-93be-bf7f132471aa">\n                <div class="card-body"><p><b>Costa Rica</b><span>&nbsp;may be more expensive than some other Central American countries, but you can certainly experience the country on a backpacker\'s budget if you take the time to investigate low-cost sleeping options like camping, hostels and small eco guest houses. Budget travelers can survive on around $30 &ndash; $50 USD per day.</span></p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class="card card-custom card-corporate">\n            <div class="card-header" id="accordion-heading015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7" role="tab">\n                                    <div class="card-title">\n                    <a role="button" data-toggle="collapse" data-parent="#accordion1" href="#accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7" aria-controls="accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7" aria-expanded="false" class="collapsed">\n                        Do you need a visa for Costa Rica?\n                        <div class="card-arrow"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class="collapse" id="accordion015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="accordion-heading015ced40-9bb8-4bb6-a54d-5dc23a4dc2d7">\n                <div class="card-body"><p><span>To enter&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>, your passport must be valid for at least three months after arrival.&nbsp;</span><b>You</b><span>&nbsp;also must have a return or onward ticket. Citizens of the United States, Canada and most European nations&nbsp;</span><b>do</b><span>&nbsp;not&nbsp;</span><b>need a visa</b><span>. Tourists are generally permitted to stay in&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>&nbsp;for up to 90 days.</span></p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n            <article class="card card-custom card-corporate">\n            <div class="card-header" id="accordion-heading6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4" role="tab">\n                                    <div class="card-title">\n                    <a role="button" data-toggle="collapse" data-parent="#accordion1" href="#accordion6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4" aria-controls="accordion6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4" aria-expanded="false" class="collapsed">\n                        What shots do I need for Costa Rica?\n                        <div class="card-arrow"></div>\n                    </a>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class="collapse" id="accordion6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="accordion-heading6e034d28-f1e2-4341-a3fa-d03b284da1d4">\n                <div class="card-body"><p><span>The CDC and WHO recommend the following vaccinations for&nbsp;</span><b>Costa Rica</b><span>: hepatitis A, hepatitis B, typhoid, yellow fever, rabies, meningitis, polio, measles, mumps and rubella (MMR), Tdap (tetanus, diphtheria and pertussis), chickenpox, shingles, pneumonia and influenza.</span></p></div>\n            </div>\n        </article>\n    </div><div></div>' to equal '\n    <div></div>'

{"data":{"webPageContentCollection":[{"title":"test","body":"<p>&lt;p&gt;By default, CSS styles controlling the appearance of form fields reside in the following dotCMS directory:&amp;nbsp;/html/css/content/forms.css. However, redefining the CSS classes controlling the styling of form fields is fairly simple.&lt;/p&gt;\\n&lt;p&gt;Setting the &lt;b&gt;$contentFormMacroCSS&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;velocity variable on the Template, Container, or in a piece of content above the form on the page will over-ride the default CSS controlling form field styling. An example of the set command to a relative path is given below:&lt;/p&gt;\\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;b&gt;#set($contentFormMacroCSS = \\\"/global/css/&lt;span&gt;&lt;font color=\\\"#3366ff\\\"&gt;mycustomcssfile.css&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/span&gt;\\\")&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;\\n&lt;p&gt;As long as the customized CSS file is read after the default dotCMS file, and before the Form itself, then the styles for the form fields will be over-ridden.&lt;/p&gt;</p>"}]}}

query IntrospectionQuery {
              __schema {
        
                queryType { name }
                mutationType { name }
                subscriptionType { name }
                types {
                  ...FullType
                }
                directives {
                  name
                  description
        
                  locations
                  args {
                    ...InputValue
                  }
                }
              }
            }
        
            fragment FullType on __Type {
              kind
              name
              description
        
              fields(includeDeprecated: true) {
                name
                description
                args {
                  ...InputValue
                }
                type {
                  ...TypeRef
                }
                isDeprecated
                deprecationReason
              }
              inputFields {
                ...InputValue
              }
              interfaces {
                ...TypeRef
              }
              enumValues(includeDeprecated: true) {
                name
                description
                isDeprecated
                deprecationReason
              }
              possibleTypes {
                ...TypeRef
              }
            }
        
            fragment InputValue on __InputValue {
              name
              description
              type { ...TypeRef }
              defaultValue
        
        
            }
        
            fragment TypeRef on __Type {
              kind
              name
              ofType {
                kind
                name
                ofType {
                  kind
                  name
                  ofType {
                    kind
                    name
                    ofType {
                      kind
                      name
                      ofType {
                        kind
                        name
                        ofType {
                          kind
                          name
                          ofType {
                            kind
                            name
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
